Description: Sonera Magnetics is a small business spun out of UC Berkeley that is building systems for neurotechnology applications. Our novel magnetic sensors enable non-invasive measurement of brain activity in a portable form factor, while operating at the same performance level as room-sized pieces of diagnostic equipment. Sonera's technology represents a major advancement in our ability to measure the brain in an effective and low-cost manner, and will dramatically expand access to neurodiagnostic tools and brain-computer interfaces. We will be designing, fabricating, and assembling these devices on-site.
